name: jev-router
description: Adds fail-open Jev workflow routing to Codex prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Advisory workflow routing with safe fallback.
interface.longDescription: Uses TypeSafe AI's Jev model to add a typed workflow, domain, risk, and execution hint before each Codex turn. Existing AgentKit rules remain authoritative, and failures silently fall back to normal routing.
defaultPrompt: Show the Jev routing hint for this task.
